title: Sky Ice Walking
description: A configurable Minecraft mod that lets you walk on air by placing ice beneath you as you move, even while jumping or flying. It also includes a customizable keybind to toggle the ability, plus crouching to descend while the ice continues placing.
body:
# Sky Ice Walking

A simple Minecraft mod that lets you walk on air by placing ice blocks under your feet.

## How It Works

When you turn on the mod, ice blocks automatically appear beneath you as you walk, allowing you to walk in the sky. You can switch between two modes:

- **3x3 Mode**: Creates a wide ice platform for stable walking
- **1x1 Mode**: Places only one block under your feet for precise movement

**Crouch Mode**: Hold crouch to break blocks below you and create descending ice platforms, letting you move downward through the air safely.

## Controls

- **Toggle Mod** (default: R key): Turn the ice walking on/off
- **Switch Mode** (default: V key): Change between 3x3 and 1x1 placement

All keybinds can be changed through Minecraft's standard controls menu in Options > Controls.

## Features

- Walk on air with automatic ice placement
- Toggle between wide and precise placement modes
- Descend through the air by crouching
- No fall damage when using crouch descent
- Simple keybind controls

## ⚠️ Important

This mod gives you movement advantages. Always check server rules before using it on multiplayer worlds. The author is not responsible for any bans or issues.

Perfect for creative building, exploring, or having fun in the sky!
